path_conditions: Caller pci_epf_test_write() is invoked via pci_epf_test_cmd_handler() which is set as the work function in INIT_DELAYED_WORK() from pci_epf_test_probe(). A workqueue handler runs in process context and is sleepable. Busy-waiting with mdelay(1) wastes a full millisecond of CPU; the fix uses usleep_range(1000, 2000) instead. The bug fits the 'delay-gfp' pattern: an atomic/busy-wait primitive (mdelay) used where a sleeping equivalent (usleep_range / msleep) is correct.
